title: NVIDIA Transforms European Retail, From Digital Discovery to Physical Operations

claims.claim: Shopify post-trained NVIDIA Nemotron 3.5 Lightning for the GraphQL subagent integrated into Sidekick, cutting serving costs by 90% and delivering responses 7x faster.

evidence.quote: Shopify has post-trained NVIDIA Nemotron 3.5 Lightning for the GraphQL subagent integrated into Sidekick, Shopify’s AI assistant for merchants.
On Shopify’s internal benchmark, the post-trained model surpasses a leading frontier model in accuracy while cutting serving costs by 90% and delivering responses 7x faster.

claims.claim: Zooplus deployed a production ready prototype inside its Amazon Web Services environment that achieved 86% search accuracy using NVIDIA Nemotron Retriever.

evidence.quote: A production ready prototype deployed inside Zooplus’ Amazon Web Services (AWS) environment achieved 86% search accuracy using the NVIDIA Nemotron Retriever library for semantic search

claims.claim: Photoroom standardizes about 40,000 images a day across 70 countries for Vestiaire Collective through its Image Editing API.

evidence.quote: Photoroom results from its deployment with Vestiaire Collective, where its Image Editing API now standardizes every primary image, about 40,000 a day across 70 countries, at the point of listing.

claims.claim: Listings processed by Photoroom sold at a 5% higher rate of liquidity, with 3% to 7% more unique views per product page.

evidence.quote: Listings processed by Photoroom sold at a 5% higher rate of liquidity, with 3% to 7% more unique views per product page.

claims.claim: Omi runs TRELLIS 3D asset generation on NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell Server Edition GPUs, speeding up inference by 10x and reducing pipeline latency by 4x.

evidence.quote: Omi runs TRELLIS 3D asset generation on NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell Server Edition GPUs, speeding up inference by 10x and reducing pipeline latency by 4x.

claims.claim: Mirakl’s Catalog Transformer has onboarded more than 70 million products.

evidence.quote: Mirakl’s Catalog Transformer pairs fine-tuned open models with proprietary services and has onboarded more than 70 million products, turning messy vendor data into accurate, well-organized catalogs.

claims.claim: CATCHES achieved production results from its RealFit deployment with AMIRI showing conversion up 55%, add-to-cart up 80% and gross sales up 56%.

evidence.quote: CATCHES achieved production results from its RealFit deployment with AMIRI of conversion up 55%, add-to-cart up 80% and gross sales up 56%, all after seasonal adjustment against like-for-like styles.

claims.claim: OrbMol-v2 is five times faster than comparable models and delivers 21% lower error than the next-best model of its kind.

evidence.quote: OrbMol-v2 is five times faster than comparable models and delivers 21% lower error than the next-best model of its kind.

Integrated with the NVIDIA ALCHEMI Toolkit and powered by NVIDIA accelerated computing, OrbMol-v2 is five times faster than comparable models and delivers 21% lower error than the next-best model of its kind.
